svg.title: 02_buildings
svg.text: Freeze the animation: generator towers, vehicle opening, personnel bays and cargo gantry still read.
NEW DESIGN PROPOSAL • 13 INTERVIEW DECISIONS PRESERVED
Twin drums rise above a low base.
Wide vehicle bay and broad ramp.
Door moves only for real production.
Keep its scale below the factory.
Open gantry, stacked cargo, clear dock.
Archetypes, not roster additions. Do not invent a power requirement or building for a faction that lacks one.
